name: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Special
summary: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Special is an arcade follow-up to the Super Famicom game Bishōjo Janshi Suchie-Pai that was later ported to several home systems. Like the original, it features Misaki Kyoko's alter ego, the superheroine Suchie-Pai, as she plays mahjong against various young, attractive female opponents. However, this game contains stripping.
